summary: One method: execute this tower's attack on a target. Lets a tower pick its style by composition.
purpose: Separates how a tower attacks from how it targets. TDTower handles range and timing and then defers to whatever implements this on the same object, so a prefab chooses hitscan or projectile by which component is attached.
whenToImplement: When adding an attack style the two built-ins do not cover — a chain attack, a slow field, an area burst.

Attack(TDEnemy, float).contract: Deal this tower's attack to the given enemy. How — instantly, with a projectile, over an area — is entirely yours.
Attack(TDEnemy, float).mustNot: Do not assume the target survives to the end of the attack. A travelling projectile must handle its target being killed mid-flight, which is exactly why TDProjectile self-destructs rather than erroring.

calledBy: TDTower, on its fire-rate timer, with the enemy it selected. Nothing else calls it.
useCases: A slowing or debuff tower that deals no damage.
A chain attack hitting several enemies.

gotchas.title: It must be on the same GameObject as the tower
gotchas.body: The tower looks locally. A behaviour on a child is not found.
